Name: QuickRun
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[b][size=5][img]https://i.ibb.co/whSDXRss/QRUN.gif[/img]

Overview[/size][/b]

QuickRun is a mod that lets you sprint without adding any new buttons to your controls.
You can start sprinting naturally by holding a direction or double-tapping the same direction.

It also supports horseback sprinting, optional grass and weed breaking while sprinting, and optional crash effects when you run into walls.

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Adds sprinting without any extra keybinds
[*]Sprint by holding a direction
[*]Sprint by double-tapping the same direction
[*]Separate settings for hold sprint and double-tap sprint
[*]Supports horseback sprinting
[*]Optional setting to disable sprinting indoors

[*]Optional sprint start effect
[*]Optional grass and weed breaking while sprinting
[*]Optional wall collision stun and screen shake
[*]Configurable sprint charge time
[*]Configurable sprint speed for both on foot and horseback
[*]In-game configuration support through Generic Mod Config Menu
[/list]

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list]

[b][size=5]Optional[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu
Install it if you want to change settings in-game.[/list]

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]

[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.
[*]Download QuickRun.
[*]Extract the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[*]Launch the game.
[/list]

[code]Mods/
QuickRun/
manifest.json

assets/
[/code]
